meta.name: talking-head-recut
meta.description: Package an existing talking-head / interview / podcast video with timed, designed GRAPHIC OVERLAY cards — kinetic titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, picture-in-picture — synced to the transcript, on a 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:5 canvas of your choice; the clip plays untouched underneath. Trigger on "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics", "package / dress up my video". Not plain subtitles (/embedded-captions). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给视频添加动态图文叠加层，同步字幕与画面
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为访谈或播客视频添加专业图文卡片
copy.tagline_en: Add timed graphic overlays to videos, synced with transcript
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add professional graphic cards to interview or podcast videos

howto.what: 装好后,当你给它一个已有的讲话、访谈或播客视频,它会按内容配上一系列定时出现的图形卡片(标题、人名条、数据标注等),和说话内容同步,视频本身保持原样,最后输出一个带包装的 MP4 成品。
howto.when: 当你要求给已有视频加图形叠加、屏幕图形,或说“包装/打扮我的视频”等关键词时触发;纯字幕需求不走这里。不确定时由 /hyperframes 路由。

say.text: 给这段访谈视频加上图形覆盖卡片,动态标题加数据标注
say.note: Claude 会分析转录并设计对应卡片。

say.text: 把这个播客视频包装一下,配上标题条、引言和画中画
say.note: 它会生成分镜并渲染带包装的 MP4。

say.text: 把视频做成竖屏 9:16,加信息条和重点数据弹窗
say.note: 可指定画布比例,它按需处理。

howto.what_en: Once installed, given an existing talking-head/interview/podcast video, it adds timed graphic cards (titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, etc.) synced to speech, keeps the original footage untouched, and renders a packaged MP4.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add graphic overlays, on-screen graphics, or say 'package/dress up my video' for an existing clip; plain subtitles don't route here.

say_en.text: Add graphic overlay cards to this interview, with titles and data callouts.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes the transcript and designs matching cards.

say_en.text: Package this podcast video with lower-thirds, quotes, and picture-in-picture.
say_en.note: It produces a storyboard and renders a packaged MP4.

say_en.text: Make this video 9:16 portrait, with info bars and key data pop-ups.
say_en.note: You can specify the canvas ratio; it handles the rest.
